```yaml
name: Copilot Agent Environment Setup
run-name: Set up Copilot agent environment for oxc project
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}
jobs:
  setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust toolchain
        uses: oxc-project/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          rust-toolchain-file: rust-toolchain.toml

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10.13.1

      - name: Install just
        run: |
          curl --proto =https --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://just.systems/install.sh | bash
          echo "$HOME/.local/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Install cargo-binstall
        run: |
          curl -L --output cargo-binstall.tar.gz https://github.com/cargo-bins/cargo-binstall/releases/latest/download/cargo-binstall-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
          tar -xzf cargo-binstall.tar.gz
          sudo mv cargo-binstall /usr/local/bin/
          rm cargo-binstall.tar.gz

      - name: Install development tools with cargo-binstall
        run: |
          cargo binstall watchexec-cli -y
          cargo binstall cargo-insta -y
          cargo binstall typos-cli -y
          cargo binstall cargo-shear -y
          cargo binstall dprint -y

      - name: Install Node.js dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Verify tool installations
        run: |
          echo "Checking just version:"
          just --version
          echo "Checking rustc version:"
          rustc --version
          echo "Checking node version:"
          node --version
          echo "Checking pnpm version:"
          pnpm --version
          echo "Checking watchexec version:"
          watchexec --version
          echo "Checking cargo-insta version:"
          cargo insta --version
          echo "Checking typos version:"
          typos --version
          echo "Checking cargo-shear version:"
          cargo shear --version
          echo "Checking dprint version:"
          dprint --version

      - name: Run cargo check
        run: cargo check

      - name: Completion message
        run: |
          echo "✅ Copilot agent environment setup complete!"
          echo ""
          echo "Available commands:"
          echo "- just ready (run all project checks)"
          echo "- just fmt (format code)"
          echo "- just test (run tests)"
          echo "- just lint (lint code)"
          echo ""
          echo "All tools have been installed and verified."
```
